name: Blizzard
source:
After transferring to the United States for his job, Minokichi feels lost and unhappy. Will his wife Oyuki stand by him?

[From [url=https://buntan.itch.io/blizzard]Itch.io[/url]]

因工作调动迁居美国后，巳之吉感到迷茫又郁郁寡欢。他的妻子阿雪是否会始终陪伴在他身旁？
